data.title: 庄方宜 · 把周末行程画给你看
data.description: 家中书桌前，庄方宜穿青瓷交领与墨蓝长裙，俯身在空白便笺上画简洁的路线草图。她停下笔把纸转向你，另一只手压住纸角，眼里有一起出门的期待。画面不要求可读文字。
data.action: 将画好的路线草图转向镜头，抬头与你商量
data.mood: 安静投入的亲近与期待
data.promptProse: Zhuang Fangyi turns the simple route sketch toward the viewer, holding one paper corner flat and keeping the pen in her other hand. Afternoon light from beside the desk falls over the lines as she looks up to discuss the outing.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the paper corner flat while the other keeps the pen.
